teaser: Beyond the headline: silent corrections, no named victim, the sites that went dark, the flaws nobody watched, and how much was AI.
core_idea: Because the PHP story site keeps every source and capture, php2shell's evolution can be examined beyond the headline: provenance, features built against real needs, who corrects reporting (including an unannounced rewording), a crisis with no named victim and possibly needless shutdowns, immature detection, the cost of sites going dark, who is paid, exploited flaws that got little attention, and thin evidence of AI-driven exploitation.
